name: VibeWave v2.4.5 - Header & Category Frame Fix
body:
### 🎨 VibeWave v2.4.5 - UI Frame & Category Chips Alignment Fix!

- 📐 **Clean Header Alignment:** VibeWave title and logo are now neatly framed in a single line without squishing.
- ⚡ **Fixed Category Chips Position:** Category chips (Trending India, Bollywood, Punjabi, etc.) are now perfectly placed directly under the top bar with no status bar overlapping!
- ✨ **Added All Chip:** Instant switch back to Home feed.
